inputs.text: This isn’t reassurance—it’s a pressure tactic. Tom Homan refusing to rule out enforcement at polling places, then asking what Democrats are “afraid of,” helps plant doubt about whether voting is safe while giving the administration room to deny it meant to intimidate anyone. The conflicting answers look less like confusion than a way to keep the threat alive without taking responsibility for it.
